wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap locates the older church envelope south of the new cathedral. The modern standing footprint controls registration. Published archaeological measurements inform the surrounding podium and stair.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the stepped Aksumite podium, three open squared bays, flat parapet and rooflet.
limitations: The model depicts the pre-1908 church appearance. The mapped envelope is the standing building, so historic side projections are approximate.
The rear elevations, roof finish, masonry colors and south and east podium edges are interpreted from the single detailed period photograph and the published measurements.
Scope includes the cathedral, its platform and the approach steps. The later new cathedral, treasuries, adjacent belfries and other precinct buildings are outside this model.
